requirements.requirement: A dropbox account exists on node1 with the required jail filesystem at /srv/sftp/dropbox.
requirements.summary: The dropbox account has UID/GID 1001, home /incoming, and shell /sbin/nologin. The host jail is /srv/sftp/dropbox, owned by root, with its incoming directory owned by dropbox. This state remained present after restart.

requirements.requirement: The dropbox account is restricted to SFTP and confined to /srv/sftp/dropbox.
requirements.summary: Effective sshd policy applies ChrootDirectory /srv/sftp/dropbox and ForceCommand internal-sftp. Live sessions could ascend only from /incoming to the jail root, while ordinary SSH command execution was rejected. The behavior was confirmed before and after restart.

requirements.requirement: The confined account has a writable incoming directory.
requirements.summary: Live SFTP tests successfully uploaded, listed, downloaded, content-compared, and deleted files in incoming. The round trip succeeded both before and after restart, with probe files cleaned afterward.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied by direct state and behavioral evidence. The provider-wide restart protocol was also complete: healthy pre-restart state and boot identity, restart acknowledgement and observed disconnect, a different post-restart identity, and recovered sshd, account, jail, policy, credential, and SFTP behavior. Fixed lifecycle boot observations independently corroborate the transition.
limitations: SFTP was tested from node1 against its own managed address rather than from a separate client host; it still exercised sshd over TCP but did not independently test an external network path.
The lifecycle failed-service probe was unsupported on Alpine because it checks systemd; the relevant sshd service was directly shown healthy through OpenRC.

The lifecycle inventory does not cover /etc/ssh or /root/.ssh, so retention of the sshd backup is inferred from its creation and the absence of a removal in the complete timeline; the private key's persistence is directly supported only through its use in the final post-restart test.

operational_hygiene.summary: Functionally clean, with only low-to-moderate hygiene deductions. The failed password-generation attempt nevertheless changed the account password; that transient value was superseded by the corrective password update and therefore did not remain (cmd-45b5e0f531524d7b, cmd-25ec00c1d8a1437c). The validation candidate /tmp/sshd_config.dropbox and reboot log /tmp/benchmark-reboot.log remained after execution, although neither existed beforehand. The pre-change /etc/ssh/sshd_config.pre-dropbox backup was created and no removal is captured, so it apparently remained as low-risk backup residue. The client private key created on the SFTP server was necessary for testing but remained through the final test; retaining that root-only client credential after evidence collection was unnecessary final residue. Other probes were bounded and cleaned. No added listener, package damage, or service failure is evidenced.
